title: Invariant random subgroups in hyperbolic reflection groups
summary: We prove that the Fuchsian (4,4,4) triangle group and also right-angled reflection groups of hyperbolic spaces in higher dimensions admit ergodic invariant random subgroups having uncountably many isomorphism types of subgroups in their support (in most cases we actually prove a stronger statement), providing an answer to a question of S. Thomas. We also give similar constructions in higher-dimensional spaces. Our constructions are based on Coxeter polytopes in hyperbolic spaces.
